errors.text_span: a shared, rotated y-axis label reads "Inference Time (minute)."
errors.evidence: This phrasing incorrectly implies that "Inference Time (minute)" is the label for the vertical (categorical) axis. In a horizontal bar chart, this label describes the values on the horizontal axis. The label is also duplicated for each chart, not shared between them.

In the right chart (QwQ-32B-Preview), the yellow bar for "Fast-Solving Prompt" visibly extends beyond the 5.0 mark, to approximately 5.2 minutes. Stating the value is 5.0 is an incorrect reading of the chart.
